_readme: Project DATA (images, links, categories, rooms) and page LAYOUT. All WORDING lives in content/site.md and content/work/<slug>.md. Ledger order = order of `projects`. `featuredOrder` = the Principal works. Per project: "room" picks the page's material (bench, arcade, bridge, notebook, museum, observatory, council, cabinet), "tier" its weight (flagship, featured, record, cabinet), "hidden": true leaves it off the site (its old URL gets a one-line stub), "related" lists slugs shown as Threads (only relations a source supports). "aliases" lists lower-case search terms for the seek line: real command, game, face, lens and tool names, never private strings. `layout.sections` orders the home page sections; `layout.hiddenSections` hides them. The preview's Edit mode changes wording and layout; apply-edits.mjs writes them back here.

A stone-brick tower with a dark oak pyramid roof, built with /hcyl 75%stone_bricks,25%cracked_stone_bricks 6 18 and /hpyramid dark_oak_planks 7.
A copper-block ring generated from a math formula with /generate, surrounded by oak trees from /forestgen 16 oak 5.
The view from inside the glass dome, past the central quartz pillar, out to the tower and the copper ring, with a floor laid in the weighted mix 60%polished_andesite,25%andesite,15%stone_bricks.

The whole test scene seen from above on a clean Paper 1.21.4 server: the plaza and glass dome, the tower, the copper ring among oak trees, and a sandstone step pyramid, all built with Bayzyl commands.
Bayzyl's tab panel in Minecraft, showing server memory use, a layer preview of a 6x3x5 clipboard, selection stats and recent command history.
